question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Ms. Suma aims to maintain ________ standards of customer care.
solution:
The correct answer is '**high**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**high standards**" is a common collocation that refers to having a superior level of quality or excellence in customer care.
 
• "High" is the appropriate word here as it aligns with the idea of maintaining excellent standards of service or care.
 
• Other options like "**loyal**," "**expensive**," and "**confident**" do not collocate naturally with "standards" in the context of customer care.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Ms. Suma aims to maintain high__ standards of customer care.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Loyal (निष्ठावान)**: does not form a natural collocation with "standards," as it refers to allegiance or faithfulness, not quality levels.
 
• **Expensive (महंगा)**: refers to cost and is not commonly used to describe "standards" in this context.
 
• **Confident (आत्मविश्वासी)**: describes a person’s attitude, but does not work with "standards" in the context of customer care.
